title: Property tests for gap emission coverage
description: WHY: the gap contract is only trustworthy if emission is total - a policy violation without a gap code is a directive that can never fire after the inversion. WHAT: add a test layer that drives the runtime through every enforcement path (close without verification, close with open gates per gate kind and scope, reserve non-ready work, reserve at capacity, verify with mismatched evidence subject, close reserved work as non-owner, container close with open descendants, summary policy failure) and asserts each thrown BorealError carries gaps whose codes are members of the checked-in enumeration, and that success-path advisory gaps appear where expected. Prefer table-driven tests over one-off cases so new gap codes fail the table until covered. Wire into pnpm test and keep runtime-level (no CLI spawning) for speed, mirroring the style in tests/runtime.
acceptanceCriteria: Table-driven test exists covering every gap code in the enumeration with at least one triggering scenario
Test fails if a new gap code is added to the enumeration without a covering scenario
closedReason: Completed table-driven enforcement gap coverage and stabilized file-lock heartbeat behavior required for full pnpm test reliability. Git checkpoint recorded as git_unavailable because .git writes are blocked in this environment.
